method: v2.5: rank causes → choose capture → lock confirmed shape that captures the cause. Adds directional wind (park bearing × wind dir, ±3 env), empirical-Bayes shrinkage (small samples regress to league), and platoon-split shape (barrel/air-pull vs THIS hand), on top of v2.4 pitch-mix fit + TRAP flags. Weights P25/Shape40/Env15/Lineup12/Src8. Statcast (Savant) air-pull/barrel/pitch-mix active.
